cl_mdma_next_day_field.q: How do you feel the day after taking ecstasy?
cl_mdma_next_day_field.short: People felt very tired and had slept less, but were not sadder than others.
cl_mdma_next_day_field.but: Two small studies; nobody tested the pills or measured sleep with a machine.
how: In London, 12 people who took ecstasy at a club were compared with 12 people who only drank alcohol.
The next day the ecstasy group felt much more tired and low on energy, and did worse at a sums test.
In Melbourne, people who took ecstasy slept about two hours less than people who use ecstasy but skipped it that weekend.
In both studies, mood the next day was about the same as in the other group.

cl_mdma_midweek_low.q: Do people feel low a few days after taking ecstasy?
cl_mdma_midweek_low.short: Two small studies disagree, so nobody knows how often a mid-week low happens.
cl_mdma_midweek_low.but: Both studies were small, and only one measured people before they took ecstasy.
how: A London study found people who took ecstasy felt sadder mid-week than people who only drank alcohol.
That study did not measure anyone before the night out, and did not count how many felt low.
A Melbourne study measured people a week before and found no difference from people who use ecstasy but skipped it.
In that study, people who slept badly felt worse, whether or not they took ecstasy.

cl_lsd_next_day_thinking.q: Is your thinking different the day after LSD?
cl_lsd_next_day_thinking.short: A few small changes, some better and some worse, which may just be chance.
cl_lsd_next_day_thinking.but: One study of 24 people after one small lab dose; mood and sleep were not measured.
how: People took LSD on one day and a dummy drink (placebo) on another day, two weeks apart.
The next morning, a few memory and word tests went a little better after LSD.
One card-sorting puzzle about switching rules went a little worse after LSD.
The researchers checked many scores without allowing for that, so some differences may be luck.

cl_pcp_prolonged_psychosis.q: Can a bad reaction to PCP last for weeks?
cl_pcp_prolonged_psychosis.short: In three reported cases, a severe breakdown lasted two to four weeks, then passed.
cl_pcp_prolonged_psychosis.but: Only three cases from 1975, and nobody tested the drugs they had taken.
how: Three young men were treated in one hospital after street drugs thought to contain PCP.
They were confused, angry and unsteady, two heard voices, and one jumped from a high window.
All three got better, and afterwards remembered little of their illness.
Earlier studies the doctors cited said the mind effects of PCP usually last about a day.

cl_pcp_psychosis_treatment.q: Does hospital medicine shorten a long breakdown after PCP?
cl_pcp_psychosis_treatment.short: Nobody knows: in three cases, the medicines did not seem to shorten it.
cl_pcp_psychosis_treatment.but: Three cases, with no comparison between treatments or with no treatment.
how: Two men were given medicines for psychosis, which did not visibly help.
The third man's medicine was stopped after he had fits.
One man calmed down when he was put in a dim, quiet room.
All three got better within a few weeks, one after he left hospital.

cl_can_thc_impairment_duration.q: How long does cannabis affect your driving skills?
cl_can_thc_impairment_duration.short: For several hours; longer after eating it than smoking it, and after bigger doses.
cl_can_thc_impairment_duration.but: These are averages from lab studies, not a safe time to drive for you.
how: Researchers pooled 80 studies in which people took THC or a dummy (placebo), then did driving and attention tests.
Soon after THC, people weaved more in their lane and reacted more slowly than after the dummy.
The effects faded over several hours, more slowly when THC was eaten than when it was smoked or vaped.
People who use cannabis every week were less affected, but nobody worked out for how long.

cl_can_sleep_lab.short: In sleep labs, cannabis taken by mouth did not change how people slept.
cl_can_sleep_lab.but: Most were CBD or mild THC medicines for people with sleep problems; smoking was not tested.
how: Six trials compared cannabis products swallowed as medicine with a dummy pill (placebo).
Sleep length, time to fall asleep, waking in the night and deep sleep did not change.
Results for dream (REM) sleep did not agree with each other.
Small studies from the 1970s with very strong THC found less dream sleep.

cl_can_stopping_sleep_lab.q: What happens to your sleep when you stop using a lot of cannabis?
cl_can_stopping_sleep_lab.short: Sleep got shorter and slower to start, with more dream sleep, in the first nights.
cl_can_stopping_sleep_lab.but: Three small studies, two of them from the 1970s with very strong lab doses.
how: Sleep was measured in a lab while people were still using cannabis and after they stopped.
After stopping, they slept less, took longer to fall asleep and had more dream (REM) sleep.
The studies only looked at the first week, so nobody knows how long it lasts.

cl_can_chs_capsaicin.q: Does hot-pepper (capsaicin) cream help cannabis hyperemesis in hospital?
cl_can_chs_capsaicin.short: Nobody knows yet: in small studies it sometimes helped and sometimes did not.
cl_can_chs_capsaicin.but: One small fair test and four weaker studies, all at risk of bias.
how: Cannabis hyperemesis means being sick again and again in some people who use a lot of cannabis.
In one small fair test, the cream did not ease sickness more than a dummy cream at the first check.
A few more people felt fully better with the cream, and sickness was lower at a later check.
Other studies disagreed; one found more people kept in hospital after the cream.

cl_can_chs_dopamine_antagonists.q: Do medicines that block dopamine help cannabis hyperemesis in hospital?
cl_can_chs_dopamine_antagonists.short: In two small studies, haloperidol and droperidol eased sickness and people went home sooner.
cl_can_chs_dopamine_antagonists.but: Only two small studies, and both medicines can cause sudden muscle spasms.
how: In a small fair test, haloperidol was compared with a usual anti-sickness medicine (ondansetron).
With haloperidol, pain and sickness eased more and people left hospital sooner.
In hospital records, people given droperidol left sooner than people not given it.
A few people had sudden muscle spasms (dystonia) after these medicines.

cl_scb_hangover_vs_cannabis.q: Is the day after worse with synthetic cannabis than with ordinary cannabis?
cl_scb_hangover_vs_cannabis.short: People who had used both said synthetic cannabis gave a slightly worse hangover.
cl_scb_hangover_vs_cannabis.but: These are memories from a 2011 online survey; nobody tested the products.
how: About a thousand people who had used both compared them in an online survey.
They said synthetic cannabis made it harder to get on with things afterwards.
They said it gave more bad feelings and fear of others while high, and much less enjoyment.
Most preferred ordinary cannabis, and said synthetic cannabis wore off sooner.
